review_notes: I read the whole of Track.lean and the Isotopy definitions in Basic.lean. Isotopy is an abbrev for HomotopyWith, and the TauCeti tree has no other uses of `track` that touch the simp set. The file has one simp lemma, `track_apply`. It rewrites `F.track p` to `(p.1, F p)`. That is the unfolding direction, it is closed by `rfl`, and it cannot loop because the RHS contains no `track`. The `.1` and `.2` projections of the result reduce under the standard Prod simp lemmas, so no separate `fst_track` or `snd_track` lemma is needed. `mem_range_track` is deliberately not tagged simp. Its docstring says `Set.mem_range` would expand the LHS first, so a simp attribute would never fire. The RHS is also a set-membership form that `Set.mem_range` would immediately unfold again, which would conflict with the normal form. I found no concrete missing, misoriented or competing simp rule. I did not run Lean, so this judgement rests only on reading the sources.
